text: こんな　ところで　ねちゃって　しょーが　ないわね！

structure.jp: しょーが　ないわね！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short spoken form of てしまう, which says the thing happened completely, often when it should not have. ねちゃって = 'going and falling asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: ねちゃって　しょーが　ない
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins the first part to the feeling that follows, giving the reason for it. ねちゃって しょーが ない = 'he fell asleep, and so he's hopeless'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end softens the sentence in a womanly way, and ね asks the listener to agree. しょーが ないわね = 'he's hopeless, isn't he'.
